LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 8.3.1 WORD CLASSES: SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How do we show where a person or thing is? 2. How do you show the position of a thing or the time something happens?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly, • Identify the prepositions of position, place and time from print or digital texts, Learners who may not turn pages to use page turners or be supported by peers. • Construct sentences using prepositions of position, place and time and display on charts, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted 1.
